description: Repository class for managing active user billing data, including fetching user emails, details, bookings, and activity status related to bookings and organizations.

classes.name: ActiveUserBillingRepository
classes.description: A class providing methods to retrieve billing and activity data for active users, including organization members, platform users, and booking details.

methods.name: getManagedUserEmailsBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Fetches emails of users managed by a platform organization identified by a subscription ID.

methods.name: getOrgMemberEmailsByOrgId
methods.description: Retrieves emails of organization members by organization ID.

methods.name: getOrgMemberDetailsByOrgId
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info (id, email, name) of organization members by organization ID.

methods.name: getActivePlatformUsersAsHost
methods.description: Finds platform-managed users who hosted at least one booking within a specified period.

methods.name: getActiveUsersAsHost
methods.description: Finds users who hosted at least one booking within a specified period, filtered by email list.

methods.name: getBookingsByHostUserId
methods.description: Retrieves bookings hosted by a specific user within a period, including attendee info.

methods.name: getBookingsByAttendeeEmail
methods.description: Retrieves bookings where a specific email was an attendee within a period.

methods.name: getActiveUsersAsAttendee
methods.description: Finds users who attended at least one booking within a period, filtered by email list.
